description.en:
Starts fading a screen back in from black over a number of frames. It is the counterpart of CMND_BLACK_FADE_OUT. The call returns straight away; use CMND_IS_BLACK_FADE to wait for the fade to finish.

Screens use the public constants SCREEN_A (0, top screen), SCREEN_B (1, bottom screen) and SCREEN_AB (2, both).
While an event has its bottom-screen background loaded (the EvSubBg image), a fade asked for SCREEN_A is applied to both screens instead.

The ev_main helper StartBlackFadeIn wraps this call together with the waiting loop.
Screen to fade in: SCREEN_A (0), SCREEN_B (1) or SCREEN_AB (2).
Length of the fade in frames (EV_FADE_QUICK = 5, EV_FADE_NORMAL = 10, EV_FADE_SLOW = 15).

examples.case: Fading back in and waiting (real usage, the body of ev_main's StartBlackFadeIn)
